title: Workspace founder
description: A founder as a person of the workspace, before and apart from any venture (founders/<handle>/founder.json, Torian 2026-10-31). The founder owns their ideas, references, inspirations and secrets; a venture links to its founder here by role instead of owning them. Owners are always humans, so the id is a person's. Real name and contact details live in founders/<handle>/_private/, which never reaches a model or a release.

id.description: Opaque, unique and permanent person id

handle.description: Unique handle, the folder name under founders/. Shown in place of the real name

verification.description: How sure the workspace is that this is the person: rises with what compliance needs. self = the founder said so

ventures.description: The ventures this founder founded or joined, by role

venture.description: The venture folder, relative to the workspace

role.description: A venture may have several founders; what each contributes is weighed from provenance, not fixed by the role

from_idea.description: The founder's idea (ideas/<id>.json) the venture grew from, if any

profile.description: Who the founder is: attributes from purpose/frameworks/founder-profile/attributes.json in the founder's own words. An agent may draft it; only the founder confirms it

confirmed_by.description: Who confirmed the profile reads true. Must be this founder (kind person, id = this id); an agent never confirms
